name: Brainwriting 6-3-5
deliverable: 108 structured ideas generated silently across six team members

steps.text: Seat six people with a three-column, five-row sheet, and restate the question on the board.
For five silent minutes, have each person write three ideas in the first column.
Pass right; add three ideas in the next column for five rounds, then count and cluster.

failure: Half-working looks like columns of restatements: people copy the idea above and change one word.
intervention: Before each pass, require a different part of the question or a new mechanism, not a rewording.
provenance: Steps written for this deck from the method's public definition; the source has no protocol.

origin.note: A structured brainwriting format; no origin given in the source.
